notes: internal/db/migrations/018_mail.sql: additive only — INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING into the existing settings table (columns key/value/secret/category all exist since 001_initial.sql) plus CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mail_deliveries and one index. No column/table dropped or renamed; revert leaves harmless seeded rows and an empty table.

Default is off: migration seeds mail.enabled='false', mail.Parse(nil) yields Enabled=false, and both TestTheDefaultsAreAnInternalRelayAndOff and the integration test assert it. Service.Send returns before resolving recipients when !config.Enabled, so a fresh install sends and records nothing.

No new unauthenticated routes: GET /api/v1/admin/mail/deliveries and POST /api/v1/admin/mail/test are both registered under require("*") in app.go:275-276. No middleware bypass, no account creation, no role escalation; approvalStepRecipients (mail.go:99) is a subset of what listApprovals already shows (role or approve permission, scope-in-reach, active internal accounts only).

Secret handling verified: putSetting forces value="" and secret=true for mail.password so only the vault cipher is stored; listSettings selects `secret_value IS NOT NULL` (never the cipher); the audit row carries value ""; integration test asserts the password string is absent from the settings list body and audit_logs. Test-send 502 returns the SMTP error text only (no credentials in Go net/smtp errors).

Tests actually exercise the code: internal/mail tests drive Deliver against a fake SMTP listener and assert the transcript (EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, dot-stuffing, AUTH presence/absence, ErrInvalid on AUTH without support, dead-relay timeout); httpapi integration test walks submit→approve→reject→muted→off→digest→test-send→dead-relay through the HTTP handlers with a recording sender and checks recipients, mail_deliveries rows, attempts=2 on retry, disabled user excluded, actor excluded. Deny paths (bad port/security/from/timeout → 400, bad recipient → 400, dead relay → 502 but submit still 200 in <2s) are asserted.

Ran locally: go build ./..., go vet, go test ./... with a throwaway postgres:16 (VENDRA_TEST_DSN) — all packages ok (httpapi 24s incl. TestMailIsOffUntilAnAdministratorTurnsItOn 2.8s); web: vitest admin-mail.test.tsx 5/5 pass, tsc -b --noEmit clean, eslint --max-warnings 0 clean.
workflows.go:465 stepList[current+1] is safe: `completed` is false only when current+1 < len(stepList). Notifications fire after tx.Commit so a rolled-back decision is never mailed.

Scope: all files in the diff belong to the feature (docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md §3.6 + PDF rebuild, README/operations one-liners, suppliers.go only changed to RETURNING the instance id). No unrelated refactors or dependency changes.

Minor, non-blocking: (1) service.go:152 the background deliver context is 2*Timeout+15s while the theoretical worst case of two attempts is ~4*Timeout+2s (dial timeout + session deadline each); only a relay that both stalls the TCP connect near the limit and then stalls the session twice could leave the row at 'queued' with a logged warning — rare and low impact. (2) mail.go:148 loginAuth's `server.Name != a.host` guard is always false because NewClient is given config.Host, so LOGIN credentials could go over a non-TLS connection if the operator configures a username against a relay that offers only LOGIN without STARTTLS; PLAIN is protected by Go's stdlib (refuses unencrypted non-localhost). Opt-in operator configuration, not a default-path risk. (3) SkipTLSVerify exists but defaults false and is validated as boolean.
